description: Every color token of a Cogit theme. A dotted name becomes a CSS custom property: dots turn into dashes and camelCase segments are kebab-cased (bg.selectedInactive -> --bg-selected-inactive). Types: color (solid #rrggbb), color-alpha (#rrggbb or #rrggbbaa), string (not a CSS variable).

bg.app.description: Window chrome: toolbar, menus, status bar, panel headers.

bg.panel.description: Sidebars and lists: repositories, branches, files, details.

bg.editor.description: Main work surface: the commit graph and the diff.

bg.hover.description: A row or a button under the pointer.

bg.selected.description: The selected row of the active panel.

bg.selectedInactive.description: The selected row of a panel that does not have the keyboard.

bg.rowStripe.description: Every second row of a long list over bg.editor. Extra token.

selected.bar.description: The 2px bar at the left edge of a selected row.

border.strong.description: Field borders, the window frame and splitter hover.

panel.activeHeader.description: Underline of the header of the panel that has the keyboard.

fg.secondary.description: Secondary text: labels, captions, panel titles.

accent.description: Accent: links, focus, primary actions, checked boxes.

fg.onAccent.description: Text and glyphs on a solid accent or status background.

focus.ring.description: Keyboard focus outline. The only token that may carry alpha.

status.move.description: Moved code and renamed paths: violet, as the diff's moved color. Extra token.

file.icon.modified.fill.description: File icon: fill of a modified or removed page (mirrors diff.del.line).

file.icon.modified.stroke.description: File icon: outline of a modified page (mirrors status.danger).

file.icon.conflict.fill.description: File icon: fill of a conflicted page (mirrors status.danger).

file.icon.overlay.added.description: File icon: added and untracked overlay (mirrors status.info).

file.icon.overlay.staged.description: File icon: staged check overlay (mirrors status.success).

file.icon.overlay.renamed.description: File icon: renamed arrow overlay (mirrors status.info).

file.icon.overlay.glyph.description: File icon: the + and ! drawn on a colored overlay (mirrors fg.onAccent).

graph.lane.neutral.description: Unticked branches: the lines and nodes of the graph that have no branch color. Lanes 0-7 are for ticked branches only.

badge.warning.bg.description: A warning badge, e.g. LF to CRLF: background.

badge.warning.fg.description: A warning badge, e.g. LF to CRLF: text.

diff.changed.line.description: Changed block (both sides, split view): line background.

diff.changed.gutter.description: Changed block: gutter (number and sign) of a line.

diff.centerGutter.action.hover.description: Center gutter action buttons under the pointer.

diff.filler.bg.description: Aligned layout: filler row opposite a side with no line there.

diff.filler.hatch.description: Aligned layout: the diagonal hatching lines of a filler row.

diff.jumpFlash.description: The change F6 or an arrow landed on, lit for a moment. Extra token.

syntax.theme.description: Name of the syntax theme. Reserved: Shiki is not wired in yet, highlighting is Lezer.

search.current.description: The current text-search match. Extra token.

overlay.scrim.description: Color behind a modal dialog, drawn at --scrim-opacity. Extra token.

shadow.color.description: Popup and dialog shadow; solid, the blur fades it. Extra token.
